content:
**PR A ships engram record-first save + hydrate (#874 split A)**

engram.save() now mirrors plainfiles.save() (R1), pinned by a cross-backend parity test (R2); adds hydrate({recordId}) as a single-record, #820-guarded upsert into the engram store (R3/R4/D1/D2), deferring on an absent binary, a non-zero engram save exit, or a contended guard instead of throwing (R5) -- the record is durable before hydrate ever runs. memory.save.engramUnsupported retired with its only call site (D7); capture-reachable.test.mjs and cli.backend-fallback.test.mjs retargeted to the deferred-not-refused shape (D8). package.json:65's MEMORY_BACKEND=plainfiles pin removed as the last commit (R8) -- memory:save is reachable, and durable, under every backend now. R7 probe (isolated temp store, ENGRAM_DATA_DIR override, engram 1.20.0): engram save --topic <id> UPSERTS by topic_key -- one row survives two saves on the same topic, carrying the second body. Real store's engram.db was byte-identical (size+mtime) before/after the probe. Full suite green under MEMORY_BACKEND=engram and MEMORY_BACKEND=plainfiles (5280/5280). R13 draft (save column flip) staged under openspec/changes/issue-874-record-first/brain-drafts/ for the maintainer's brain:promote after this PR merges. Split B (share() reshape, ledger rows 1-5 deletion) is a separate stacked PR, base = this PR's merge commit.
